integrity: All ternary square-free words through length 37 are regenerated from the definition. Circular square-freeness is checked exactly, and two independent extremality tests agree on all 540 linear boundary representatives before rotation and symmetry reduction.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies only the length-36 boundary. It does not enumerate other attainable lengths or determine asymptotic orbit counts. Unpublished finite-search output from the source authors could contain the same boundary census.
title: Complete length-\(36\) census for extremal square-free ternary circular words
